clauses.summary: Clock is the only time source

flag.name: new Date construction
flag.source: export const stampNow = (): number => new Date().getTime();

allow.name: injected clock
allow.source: export const stamp = (clock: { readonly now: () => number }): number => clock.now();

allow.name: parsing a date string
allow.source: export const parsed = (request: { readonly text: string }): number => Date.parse(request.text);
